what: An app that tells me what to cook tonight using whatever's already in my fridge.
who_for: Busy people who hate deciding what to make and end up wasting groceries.
matters_most: It should give me a doable recipe in seconds without me typing in a hundred ingredients.
annoys_you: Other recipe apps make you search forever and assume you have everything. I want it to work with what I actually have.
you_judge: Whether the suggestions actually feel appetizing and realistic, and whether it's fast enough that I don't lose patience.
